audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Gnar level 3 while the prose (whys[2], spikes[1]) says Aatrox's full Q-chain out-damages Gnar at 3; packet levelChart also gives 3 to Aatrox. Full-layer phases[6] said Gnar while content win[6] said Skill.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade (Q, 14/12/10/8/6s) is a three-swing chain and Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) grounds; at 3 Aatrox has both plus Deathbringer Stance healing, which beats Gnar's Mini poke in a stand-up trade.
audit.corrected: Level 3 -> Aatrox; 2+ items -> Skill (matches content win[6] and the teamfight-vs-duel split).

audit.why: Spikes are keyed to Rage, not level: GNAR! (R) exists only in Mega form on 90/60/30s, Aatrox spikes at 3 (full Q-chain), 6 (World Ender, 120/100/80s) and first item. The mirror audit states the same.
audit.corrected: Kept: read the Rage bar, not the level; Aatrox holds World Ender for your transform.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the page stated that Infernal Chains grounds. The text repeatedly told the player to Hop out of the chains zone, which is exactly what grounding prevents.
audit.why: Aatrox W carries the grounding flag and Riot's text drags champions back to the centre if they do not leave the zone. Hop (E) is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s — grounded, it is unavailable, so the escape must be Hyper's move speed (or leaving before the drag).
audit.corrected: Infernal Chains grounds: walk out on Hyper's move speed, not Hop. Mirror side states the same interaction from Aatrox's view (hold W for Hop).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[2] wrote 'Darkin Blade'; the ability is The Darkin Blade.
audit.why: Packet flagged it as a probable wrong name and the kit confirms the exact string.
missingInteractions flagged anti-heal; report[8].t and breakdown.late already call for Oblivion Orb / Executioner's early against Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender healing.

edits.after: His full The Darkin Blade Q1-Q2-Q3 chain lands, and Infernal Chains grounds you inside the zone, so Hop cannot leave it — his sweetspot knockups and passive heal win any extended trade.

edits.before: His full Darkin Blade Q-chain plus Infernal Chains and passive heal out-damage my poke in any trade I stand in for at 3.
edits.after: His full The Darkin Blade Q-chain plus Infernal Chains grounding my Hop and passive heal out-damage my poke in trades at 3.

edits.after: Boomerang-poke between his slow Q windups, then walk clear of Infernal Chains on Hyper's move speed — it grounds, so Hop cannot save you

notes: Level-chart flips are proposed as one group (win[2] on content; phases[2].side/.rating/.why and phases[6].side on full) so the two layers and the packet chart agree. The Infernal Chains grounding interaction was absent from both layers and contradicted existing advice to Hop out; it is now stated on both the spike and the wants line, matching the Aatrox-side mirror audit.
